q: Where are the most Danish kings and queens buried?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2023 and May 2025 exams.

da.q: Hvor ligger flest danske konger og dronninger begravet?

learn.text: Since the beginning of the 1400s, Roskilde Cathedral has been the Danish royal family's preferred burial church. About 40 Danish kings and queens, more than anywhere else, are buried here.

q: What function did Kronborg Castle in Helsingør have until 1857?

options.t: Burial place of Danish kings and queens
Collecting toll from ships sailing through Øresund

answerText: Collecting toll from ships sailing through Øresund
appeared: It appeared in the November 2024 exam.

da.q: Hvilken funktion havde Kronborg Slot i Helsingør frem til 1857?
options: Gravsted for danske konger og dronninger
Opkrævning af told fra skibe, der sejlede gennem Øresund
da.answer: Opkrævning af told fra skibe, der sejlede gennem Øresund

learn.text: From 1429 ships through Øresund had to pay the Sound Dues, abolished in 1857. Kronborg, at Helsingør, was built to secure the Sound Dues: until 1857 its job was to collect toll, told, from every ship sailing through the Øresund.

q: On which Danish island does the ruin Hammershus lie?

learn.text: Hammershus, built in the 1200s, was abandoned in 1743 and is Northern Europe's largest castle ruin. Bornholm has four round churches, and Østerlars is the largest, from about 1150.
